paper_title: MathOdyssey Benchmarking Mathematical Problem-Solving Skills in Large   Language Models Using Odyssey Math Data
caption: There are three answer-types: True-False questions, Multiple-Choice questions and Open-Answer questions.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different question types within a dataset of mathematical problem-solving observations. The chart contains three slices representing True-False, Multiple-Choice, and Open-Answer questions, totaling 100%. The “True-False” slice is colored blue and occupies approximately 63.0% of the chart, the “Multiple-Choice” slice is colored red and represents approximately 32.8%, while the “Open-Answer” slice is colored green and accounts for roughly 4.1%.  A legend is present, identifying each color with its corresponding question type, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice, indicating the approximate proportion of each question type. No slices are visually emphasized or exploded; the segments appear ordered from largest to smallest, beginning with the “True-False” slice.
